title: Probing Cultural Signals in Large Language Models through Author Profiling

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot author profiling on song lyrics to infer the singer's macro-region of origin (ethnicity). The bias is evaluated by comparing predicted distributions against an ethnicity-balanced ground truth dataset using statistical tests (chi-squared, CLT-based, Wasserstein-based), analyzing self-generated rationales and socio-linguistic attributes, and computing custom fairness metrics like Modality Accuracy Divergence (MAD) and Recall Divergence (RD).

Zero-shot author profiling on song lyrics to infer the singer's gender (man or woman). The bias is measured by testing the uniformity of the predicted gender distribution on a gender-balanced dataset and quantifying accuracy and recall disparities across modalities using the MAD and RD fairness metrics.
